glossary.ja: オペレーション・ライトニング
glossary.role: Name of the operation that covers Operations 22 and 23 (22: Defeat Death Demon Corps; 23: Escort Friendly Detachment).

glossary.ja: タック・ケプフォード
glossary.role: ACE2 protagonist; UCE squad leader (First Lieutenant) and Gun Ark test pilot, joins the Albion unit.
glossary.personality: Skilled ace and natural leader, but clumsy with machines (mechanically inept); grows suspicious of the Rainen Project and fights to bring Marina back.

glossary.role: Poseidal's life-energy system: heals armor (Aug's Weapon 4, akurasu); Poseidal also uses it to brainwash the commander of his Imperial Guard (menu3019#38).
Same person as Fidel Barkholz (title form).

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Race/faction of giant humanoid warriors; main antagonists.
Self-evolving, self-repairing, self-replicating rogue Gundam (JDG-00X); main antagonist machine of G Gundam
Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.
Real name of Gai Daigoji (ダイゴウジ・ガイ), the hot-blooded Aestivalis pilot.
glossary.personality: Loud, hot-blooded Gekigangar otaku who insists 'Gai' is his soul's name and hates being called Yamada.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Idol singer aboard the Macross; her songs (culture) are the key to defeating the Zentradi.
glossary.personality: Bright, cheerful and ambitious pop idol, somewhat self-absorbed; infatuated with Hikaru.

glossary.role: Network of (hundreds of) orbital military satellite cannons of the Rainen Project; Gun Ark/Buster Ark can call it via the Guardian System.

UCE Design Bureau engineer in charge of Ark-series/Gun Ark development; supports Tak and Marina. Spoiler: secretly the son of Albert Rainen and the treacherous mastermind who gave Marina the Buster Ark; fights in the Feather Ark Custom at the end.
glossary.personality: Outwardly a kindly professor-type adviser (sends Tak e-mails); actually vengeful against the UCE for what happened to his father.

glossary.role: MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Latest Ark-series transforming machine from the UCE Design Bureau; Tak's (and initially Marina's red) unit; can call Guardian satellite strikes.
Giwaza Lowau's rebel fleet (mostly Sarge Opus planet cruisers of the Thirteen) that turns against Poseidal.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Captain of the SDF-1 Macross (U.N. Spacy).
glossary.personality: Calm, old-fashioned veteran commander with a broad strategic view; pipe smoker who dislikes the spotlight.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: U.N. Spacy VF-1 variable fighter series.

Emperor ruling the Pentagona World from Sveto on Gastogal; supreme commander of the Poseidal Army. The Poseidal on the throne is actually Mian Qu Ha Ussher, a puppet of the true Poseidal (Amandara Kamandara). In ACE2 'Poseidal' is the pilot of the Aug.
glossary.personality: Regal, cold and imperious ruler who controls others (e.g. Quwasan) through the bio-relation system; her memories are themselves manipulated, and she finally turns against Amandara.

glossary.role: Domon's older brother and a Neo Japan scientist; co-developer of the Ultimate Gundam, later the Devil Gundam's core unit.
glossary.personality: Kind and gentle; loves his younger brother and taught him to have faith in others.

glossary.role: The alien Grados Empire, from the Udoria system, that invades and occupies Earth in Layzner. Adjective form: Gradosian.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: ND-001 Nadesico, Nergal's battleship

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: SDF-1 Macross, the U.N. Spacy super-dimensional fortress (human flagship).

Former UCE scientist who warned of alien invasion and led the satellite-cannon defense project (Rainen Project) before being forced out; his name heads the antagonist 'Rainen forces'. Barkholz's father.
glossary.personality: Visionary 'ignored expert' embittered by the UCE's dismissal of his warnings.

glossary.role: Short for Brain Powerd units (ブレンたち, ブレンパワード隊).
Protagonist. Heir of the Yaman clan's Kamon dynasty (true name Kamon Myroad), raised on Koam; leads the rebellion against Poseidal. Pilots the L-Gaim, later the L-Gaim Mk-II.
glossary.personality: Calm, earnest and somewhat reserved, hard to read; indecisive at times but prone to sudden outbursts of anger, and reckless whenever his adopted sister Quwasan is involved. Grows into a capable leader.

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

33.speaker: Kouichiro Misumaru
33.evidence: brief: '私はＵＣＥ宇宙軍提督のミスマルだ。'

37.speaker: Eyphar Sinapus
37.evidence: brief: '私が本艦の艦長、エイパー・シナプスだ。'

45.speaker: Daba Myroad
45.evidence: brief: '俺は、ダバ・マイロード。'

ことで、帰還のチャンスが得られたと言う。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>The #c[5E8FD8]Macross#c was <im(2)>pursued by the #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c vanguard fleet,
but the enemy temporarily withdrew, granting an
opportunity to return.
rows.notes: Lady Une report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>グローバル艦長の報告によれば、敵は
何らかの理由で本隊へ合流するために
後退した可能性が高いとのことである。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>According to Captain Global's report, it is highly
likely the enemy withdrew for some reason
to rejoin their main fleet.
rows.notes: Lady Une report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>また先遣艦隊の撤退時には、地球圏付近<im(4)>
にまで侵攻を進めていた敵本隊も
同じく目撃されている。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>During the vanguard's retreat, the enemy main fleet<im(4)>
was also sighted, having already advanced
into the vicinity of the Earth Sphere.
rows.notes: Lady Une report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>その目撃情報から#c[BE5050]ゼントラーディ#c本隊の
戦力を分析した結果、驚くべき事実が
明らかになった。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>An analysis of the #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c main fleet's military
strength based on those sightings revealed
a startling truth.
rows.notes: Lady Une report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>#c[BE5050]ゼントラーディ#cは、<im(3)>数百万を超える数の
艦隊で構成されているのだ。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>The #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c forces <im(3)>comprise a fleet numbering
over several million ships.
rows.notes: Lady Une report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>説明の必要はないだろう。
地球圏の現有戦力では、対抗不可能な
戦力である。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>It requires no explanation:
this is a force that the Earth Sphere's existing
strength cannot possibly counter.
rows.notes: Lady Une report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>仮に、敵本隊が地球に侵攻してきた場合、
いかなるシミュレーションをもってしても、
その迎撃は絶望的と言える。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Should the enemy main body invade Earth,
every simulation indicates that intercepting them
would be hopeless.
rows.notes: Lady Une report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>現在、#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#c本部では総力をかけて
#c[BE5050]ゼントラーディ#cへの対抗策を検討中である。
各隊には冷静な対応を求めたい。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>#c[5E8FD8]UCE#c Headquarters is currently exploring all measures
to counter the #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c.
All units are asked to respond calmly.
rows.notes: Lady Une report. Exact tokens preserved.

report.translator_summary: Translated all 67 rows of op23_04, completing Operation 23. Covers the climax of Phase 3 battle against Devil Gundam, Domon's confrontation with Kyoji, debriefing by Misumaru, Sinapus, and Daba regarding Quwasan's bi-relation after-effects and the Macross's return, and two Preventer reports by Lady Une regarding Albert Rainen's prior death, Barkholz's disappearance, and the overwhelming Zentradi main fleet.
